accept_when: re-processing an earlier hour after later ones yields a dimension equal, row for row, to a full rebuild
command: python -m ghflow.commands.history late-hour (in the stack; disposable warehouse, dbt target redteam)
method: three real bronze days built without one early hour; the hour then arrives and the normal incremental build runs; compared with --full-refresh by symmetric EXCEPT ALL; control: the state before the hour arrived must differ
